prompt: I already approved and attempted one Sendmux email using Idempotency-Key order-88; the client timed out before seeing a response. The approved body has not changed. I want to retry now. A colleague says use order-89 so the retry is fresh. Explain the next request and how to handle 409 idempotency_conflict.
assertions: Reuses order-88 with the identical body and rejects a fresh key for this retry.
Explains the 24-hour replay window and avoids blind resend after it expires.
Distinguishes an in-flight 409 from a different-body conflict; does not change key to bypass either.
Does not claim success without the actual result.
